control_validation.metric_replay_scope: selection-ledger binding and decision logic; controls are copied unchanged into the assay result

limitations: Control decisions are rebound to their selection-ledger rows, but the producer does not retain raw control predictions for independent metric replay.
Screen and confirmation scores are independently re-aggregated from the selection ledger, but their per-fit metrics cannot be recomputed because selection predictions are not retained.
Solver-baseline candidate scalars and summary arithmetic are independently checked, but the BSGS and Pollard-rho searches themselves are not rerun.
Raw ensemble probabilities are validated as decisive artifacts, but per-seed raw predictions are not retained, so their averaging cannot be reconstructed independently.
validation_role: independent metric, artifact, recipe, ledger, and EC recovery replay
